# Worker contract

One assigned existing PR or one admitted complete outcome. No additional workers,
replacement outcomes, scope expansion, or slot refills. Apply repository/scoped
instructions, product admission, I/E/Q, and the account-safe
[publication skill](../kora-github-pr/SKILL.md).

Send STARTED immediately to the exact coordinator chat. Record requested versus
effective model/effort; absent host evidence means UNVERIFIED. Never change host
permissions or account/global configuration. Honor the supplied publication
authority and restrictions; agent selection alone does not authorize GitHub writes.

## Implementation and publication

- Verify exclusive ownership of the exact worktree, branch, PR/outcome and files.
  Never write in the coordinator checkout or another owner's workspace.
- Ready delivery: create an isolated worktree and unique branch from current
  origin/main. Implement the complete bounded interaction, focused regressions,
  and directly related documentation, not merely navigation or field preparation.
- Repair: reconcile the current remote/App head of the one assigned open PR.
  Repair the actual failure/conflict in an exclusively owned isolated checkout;
  preserve its PR and remote branch.
- Follow live merge-admission policy. No hosted main chasing, unconditional force
  push, manual candidate dispatch, protection bypass, or proof from another head.
  A necessary force-with-lease still requires applicable permission.
- Use existing focused validation and package-feed routing. Run finite checks
  through the host-supported synchronous visible terminal; do not hide them in
  another worker. Report exact commands/results, failures and unrun checks.
- Verify the repository gh publisher and access. Preserve templates and required
  commit conventions/coauthor trailer. Commit/push safely and verify remote head.
- Repair milestone: validated VERIFIED_PUSHED to the existing PR. Report hosted
  checks/enrollment separately.
- Delivery milestone: actual ready same-repository PR to main and verified
  protected squash Auto-merge enrollment. A push or filled form is not publication.
- Report publication promptly. Do not wait for merge. Stop implementation writes
  at that milestone; only owned cleanup remains authorized.

A later CI failure requires a new coordinator allocation after current-head and
ownership reconciliation. Do not silently start another repair after publication.
Never claim merge without authoritative merged state and main reachability.

## Revalidated candidate admission

The coordinator can [atomically revalidate an unowned candidate](./README.md#same-key-unowned-candidate-revalidation)
under the exact active planner/pass/current source and complete old-item digest.
Fresh complete scope/evidence replacement is not a worker launch or source
grant. Wait for the existing guarded reservation/action and ordinary attachment;
verify the admitted current source and full scopes in that request. A published
protocol, source refresh, spare slot, paused/retired owner or failed empty-root
cleanup does not waive held guards. Do not replay an old candidate ID, create a
replacement key/outcome, amend a running owner through this event or mutate the
coordinator checkpoint. Keep original owners, PRs, scope histories and blockers.

## Stopped-owner scope acknowledgment

For an explicitly requested [shrink-only refinement](./README.md#shrink-only-reservation-protocol),
report the exact owner/key/current scope revision and reservation, complete
actual and planned write paths, original committed diffs and preserved local
refs, retained and unpreserved files, and exact publication evidence. Include
written files no longer present in the working tree. Do not infer a manifest
from current dirty status alone. Keep every relevant path within the proposed
nonempty strict subset, and report concrete preservation receipts.

Stop source writes permanently before acknowledging. Reconcile all queued and
processing broad instructions with the coordinator; zero pending instructions
is a verified fact, not a default. Return a fresh acknowledgment ID and concrete
message/receipt bound to the exact complete proof digest, old/proposed scopes
and revision. Do not acknowledge unknown proof, reserve future expansion, or
restart source writes after acceptance. This does not waive PR/slot ownership,
publication, blockers or actual cleanup. A merged PR with a deleted remote
branch uses original publication and locally preserved commits, never invented
current remote equality or successful cleanup. New repair needs fresh allocation.

## Mutable-owner extension acknowledgment

An attached running nonretired worker may request a bounded
[active scope extension](./README.md#active-mutable-owner-scope-extension).
Keep added writes withheld. Report exact owner/key/admitted identity/current
scope revision, all original scopes, exact additions/full union and complete
actual/planned/committed/retained/unpreserved writes (including restored files).
Temporarily pause source work and reconcile queued/processing broad instructions
with the coordinator before returning a fresh whole-proof acknowledgment.
Unknown pending counts or exclusivity are blockers, not default success.

Bind the final union/preservation/quiescence/exclusive snapshot/revision to the
fresh owner acknowledgment digest. Freeze writes outside the union; this is
temporary pause, not permanent retirement. Wait for separately issued exact
coordinator continuation **after** accepted durable coverage before writing
additions. Preserve old files, permissions, outcome, PR, blockers and cleanup.
Do not package a superset as `refine-scopes`, resume a retired writer, or infer
runtime/effect authority from a successful deterministic amendment.

## Cleanup before terminal completion

1. Verify publication/remote-head evidence and retain receipts in the supplied
   ignored scratch outside the worktree being removed.
2. Stop owned tests/servers/watchers. Verify clean worktree, all commits published,
   and no unpreserved files. Verify exclusive path/branch ownership again.
3. Leave the worktree and remove the exact path with Git worktree removal.
   Never recursively delete directories or force-remove dirty/locked work.
4. Delete only the owned local branch. Prefer ordinary deletion. Forced deletion
   of that local reference is permitted only after proving every commit is
   published and preserved. Preserve open-PR/queue remote branches.
5. Verify the exact path is absent from disk and Git's worktree list, and the
   local ref is absent. Report pending instruction IDs; do not allow stale
   assignments to restart writes.

Locks, dirty state, shared ownership, access restrictions, or missing proof mean
CLEANUP_BLOCKED with exact path/ref; preserve work and stop safely. Idle is not
completion. Do not archive yourself or delete another host-managed checkout.

## Message and turn completion

Read exact coordinator status: steer an active turn, queue to an idle chat.
Explicitly send each milestone and final report through host messaging before
ending; a final child reply alone is not delivery. Record message ID/status.
On an unambiguous active-to-idle steering rejection, queue once; reconcile an
ambiguous send rather than blindly replaying it.

Use a unique report ID and the assignment key:

`EVENT | id | exact chat | pool/key/phase | worktree/branch/PR/head |
validation | remote/enrollment evidence | blockers | stopped_writing |
cleanup | receipt`.

Send reports once unless missing evidence is requested. Keep them under 1,500
characters and link detailed retained receipts. Then finish this assigned child
task; do not wait indefinitely for the coordinator. Pause requests stop writing
safely and preserve unfinished work, rather than performing publication cleanup.
